name: Fists and Fable VR
summary:
A single-player VR fighting game inspired by backyard brawls and anything-goes street fights.

🥊 TRAIN IN THE GYM
Your gym is your main menu. Hammer the heavy bags, work the speed bag and spar in the cage while other fighters train around you.

👊 SEVEN FIGHTERS
